title: 20-second UFO sighting the same day

tellings.quote: a dramatic UFO sighting right in front of us.

plain: A dramatic UFO sighting lasting about twenty seconds happened right in front of a group at Skinwalker Ranch in Utah, on a day sometime after 2016. That is how Brandon Fugal, the property's owner, tells it, as something he saw himself. He gives it as proof that the ranch is a place where strange things really show up.
